description: Search INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder) for cosmetic products and ingredients by name. Returns names, slugs, and URLs — one page at a time. Pass a result's slug to inkeedecoder_get_product or inkeedecoder_get_ingredient for the full page. Read-only: it never modifies anything.

page.description: 1-based page number. Each response states whether another page is available.

query.description: Product name, brand, or ingredient name — for example "squalane", "niacinamide", or "The Ordinary Retinol 1% in Squalane".

tab.description: Return only this tab. Omit it to get page 1 of both products and ingredients in a single request; with `tab` set, any page costs exactly one request.

name: inkeedecoder_search

ingredients.description: Ingredient matches. Present when no `tab` was requested.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

products.description: Product matches. Present when no `tab` was requested.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

results.description: Matches from the requested tab. Present when `tab` was set.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

title: Search products and ingredients
